mcp_integration_guide.overview: This guide explains how to use the IBM Concert MCP Server tools within the ConcertDef SBOM mode to upload generated SBOMs and vulnerability scan reports directly to IBM Concert.

concert_mcp_server.description: The Concert MCP Server provides two tools for interacting with IBM Concert APIs: 1. upload_application_sbom - Upload ConcertDef SBOM files 2. upload_vulnerability_scan - Upload vulnerability scan reports

tool_1_upload_application_sbom.name: upload_application_sbom
tool_1_upload_application_sbom.purpose: Upload generated ConcertDef SBOM files to IBM Concert

when_to_use.scenario: After successfully generating a ConcertDef SBOM file
When user explicitly requests to upload SBOM to Concert
As part of automated SBOM generation and upload workflow

parameter.name: file_path
parameter.description: Absolute or relative path to the SBOM JSON file

usage_pattern.step: 1. Generate ConcertDef SBOM file using write_to_file
3. Use use_mcp_tool to upload the SBOM

tool_1_upload_application_sbom.example_usage:
After generating the SBOM file, upload it to Concert:
<use_mcp_tool> <server_name>concert</server_name> <tool_name>upload_application_sbom</tool_name> <arguments> { "file_path": "./my-application-sbom.json" } </arguments> </use_mcp_tool>

success.action: Confirm upload to user and document in generation notes

failure.action: Report error message to user and suggest corrections

tool_2_upload_vulnerability_scan.name: upload_image_scan / upload_code_scan / upload_vm_scan
tool_2_upload_vulnerability_scan.purpose: Upload vulnerability scan reports to IBM Concert

when_to_use.scenario: When user wants to upload original scan reports to Concert
To provide vulnerability data alongside SBOM

tool_2_upload_vulnerability_scan.critical_requirement: MUST include application_name and application_version for successful upload. The application_name should match the component name used in the ConcertDef SBOM. Without these, Concert will reject the upload with "Data processing wasn't successful" error.

parameter.name: file_path
parameter.description: Path to the vulnerability scan report file

parameter.name: application_name
parameter.description: Name of the application in Concert (must match SBOM component name)

parameter.name: metadata
parameter.description: Metadata as JSON object - MUST include application_version

optional_fields.field: scan_date - When the scan was performed

usage_pattern.step: 1. Identify scan report file(s) used for SBOM generation
2. Determine scanner type from report structure
4. Use use_mcp_tool to upload each scan report

tool_2_upload_vulnerability_scan.example_usage:
Upload a Grype CycloneDX scan report (CORRECT FORMAT):
<use_mcp_tool> <server_name>concert</server_name> <tool_name>upload_image_scan</tool_name> <arguments> { "file_path": "./digitalbank.json", "application_name": "digibank", "scanner_name": "grype", "metadata": { "application_version": "2.1.0", "image_name": "digisic/digitalbank", "format": "CycloneDX" } } </arguments> </use_mcp_tool>
Upload a Trivy scan report with required metadata:
<use_mcp_tool> <server_name>concert</server_name> <tool_name>upload_image_scan</tool_name> <arguments> { "file_path": "./trivy-scan-report.json", "application_name": "myapp", "scanner_name": "trivy", "metadata": { "application_version": "1.0.0", "scan_date": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z", "environment": "production", "branch": "main" } } </arguments> </use_mcp_tool>

success.action: Confirm upload to user with scanner name and file

failure.action: Report error and suggest checking file path and scanner name

complete_workflow_example.title: Generate SBOM and Upload to Concert
complete_workflow_example.description: Complete workflow showing SBOM generation from scan reports and upload to Concert

step.details: Parse scan reports to identify containers, libraries, repositories

step.critical_note: MUST extract component name from scan report and use as application_name. MUST include application_version in metadata.
step.example:
For CycloneDX/Grype scan: <use_mcp_tool> <server_name>concert</server_name> <tool_name>upload_image_scan</tool_name> <arguments> { "file_path": "./digitalbank.json", "application_name": "digibank", "scanner_name": "grype", "metadata": { "application_version": "2.1.0", "image_name": "digisic/digitalbank", "scan_date": "2024-01-15" } } </arguments> </use_mcp_tool>
For Trivy scan: <use_mcp_tool> <server_name>concert</server_name> <tool_name>upload_image_scan</tool_name> <arguments> { "file_path": "./trivy-report.json", "application_name": "myapp", "scanner_name": "trivy", "metadata": { "application_version": "1.0.0", "scan_date": "2024-01-15", "environment": "production" } } </arguments> </use_mcp_tool>

step.include: - Scan reports analyzed - Components identified - SBOM file generated - Upload results (success/failure) - Timestamps

practice.title: Upload Order
practice.description: Upload SBOM first, then scan reports
practice.rationale: Concert can correlate scan data with SBOM components

practice.title: Include Metadata
practice.description: Always include meaningful metadata with scan uploads
practice.rationale: Helps track scan context and history in Concert

practice.title: Verify Before Upload
practice.rationale: Prevents upload failures due to schema violations

practice.title: Document Uploads
practice.description: Record upload results in generation documentation
practice.rationale: Provides audit trail and troubleshooting information

practice.title: Handle Errors Gracefully
practice.description: Check upload responses and report errors clearly
practice.rationale: Helps users understand and resolve upload issues

issue.name: MCP Server Not Available
issue.symptoms: Error about concert server not found

solutions.solution: Verify Concert MCP server is configured in MCP settings
Check that concert-mcp-server is built (npm run build)
Restart MCP client to reload server configuration
Verify config.json has correct API credentials
Check instance_id and api_key are valid
Use absolute paths or verify relative paths are correct
Check file was created successfully before upload
Verify all required fields are present
